scope: AIC-REQ-04 capability discovery typography; not a whole-site marketing redesign

checks.item: **Brief inference** declared (Section 0.B one-liner)?
checks.evidence: Developer capability discovery; preserve-mode typography repair.

checks.item: **Dial values** explicit and reasoned from the brief, not silently using baseline?
checks.evidence: DESIGN_VARIANCE 3, MOTION_INTENSITY 2, VISUAL_DENSITY 5; information reading over marketing motion.

checks.item: **Design system** chosen from Section 2 if applicable, or aesthetic labeled honestly?
checks.evidence: Existing native HTML/ESM/CSS and brand tokens preserved; no claim of using an official external design system.

checks.item: **Redesign mode** detected and audit performed (if applicable, Section 11)?
checks.evidence: Audit of brand/tokens, IA, copy, existing selected screenshots and current DOM completed before changing CSS.

checks.item: **ZERO em-dashes (`—`) anywhere on the page.** Headlines, eyebrows, pills, body, quotes, attribution, captions, buttons, alt text. Zero. (Section 9.G - non-negotiable.)
checks.evidence: Canonical source-quoted catalog descriptions and existing guidance punctuation are preserved; no whole-page zero-dash compliance claimed. No new UI copy/dashes introduced.

checks.item: **Page Theme Lock**: ONE theme (light, dark, or auto) for the whole page. No section flips to inverted mode mid-page (Section 4.11)?
checks.evidence: Global theme retained, tested in both modes.

checks.item: **Color Consistency Lock**: one accent color used identically across all sections (Section 4.2)?
checks.evidence: One rust action accent; existing green denotes a different semantic support relationship and is deliberately retained.

checks.item: **Shape Consistency Lock**: one corner-radius system applied consistently (Section 4.4)?
checks.evidence: 4px content/control radius; documented existing 8px mobile sheet exception.

checks.item: **Button Contrast Check**: every CTA text is readable against its background (no white-on-white, WCAG AA 4.5:1)?
checks.evidence: Existing palette unchanged; measured light/dark button/text contrast recovery cases pass.

checks.item: **CTA Button Wrap**: no CTA label wraps to 2+ lines at desktop?
checks.evidence: View/lookup controls and desktop navigation fit; multiline skill information buttons are content, not CTA slogans.

checks.item: **Form Contrast Check**: form inputs, placeholders, focus rings, labels all pass WCAG AA against the section background?
checks.evidence: No input/form styling or flow changed; existing clipboard/manual recovery retained.

checks.item: **Serif discipline**: if a serif is used, it is NOT Fraunces or Instrument_Serif (or it is, with explicit brand justification)? Different serif from your previous project?
checks.evidence: Existing native system sans stack retained.

checks.item: **Premium-consumer palette check**: if the brief is premium-consumer (cookware / wellness / artisan / luxury), the palette is NOT the AI-default beige+brass+oxblood+espresso family? Different family from your previous premium-consumer project?
checks.evidence: Developer capability discovery, not premium consumer.

checks.item: **Italic descender clearance**: every italic word with `y g j p q` has `leading-[1.1]` min + `pb-1` reserve?
checks.evidence: No italic display type introduced.

checks.item: **Hero fits the viewport**: headline ≤ 2 lines, subtext ≤ 20 words AND ≤ 4 lines, CTA visible without scroll, font scale planned around image?
checks.evidence: Homepage hero outside this bounded repair.

checks.item: **Hero top padding**: max `pt-24` at desktop, hero content does not float halfway down the viewport?
checks.evidence: Homepage hero outside this bounded repair.

checks.item: **Hero stack discipline**: max 4 text elements in hero (eyebrow OR brand strip, headline, subtext, CTAs)? No tiny tagline below CTAs, no trust micro-strip in hero?
checks.evidence: Homepage hero outside this bounded repair.

checks.item: **EYEBROW COUNT (mechanical)**: count instances of `uppercase tracking` micro-labels above section headlines across all components. Count ≤ ceil(sectionCount / 3)? Hero counts as 1.
checks.evidence: No new eyebrows; capability heading remains plain.

checks.item: **Split-Header Ban**: no "left big headline + right small explainer paragraph" pattern as a section header (vertical stack instead)?
checks.evidence: Heading and explainer remain stacked.

checks.item: **Zigzag Alternation Cap**: no 3+ consecutive sections with the same image+text-split layout?
checks.evidence: No new image/text or zigzag sections.

checks.item: **No Duplicate CTA Intent**: no two CTAs with the same intent ("Get in touch" + "Let's talk" both on page = Fail)?
checks.evidence: One view-switch group and one shared lookup; no new duplicate marketing CTA introduced.

checks.item: **Logo wall = logo only**: no industry / category labels printed below logos?
checks.evidence: No logo wall changes.

checks.item: **Bento Background Diversity**: at least 2-3 bento cells have real visual variation (image, gradient, pattern), not all white-on-white text cards?
checks.evidence: Six functional classification disclosures are owner-approved, not marketing bento.

checks.item: **"Used by / Trusted by" logo wall** lives UNDER the hero, not inside it, uses REAL SVG logos (Simple Icons / devicon) or generated SVG marks, NOT plain text wordmarks?
checks.evidence: No social-proof changes.

checks.item: **Copy Self-Audit**: every visible string re-read, no grammatically-broken or AI-hallucinated phrases ("free on its past" type) shipped?
checks.evidence: Names/IDs/purposes/call captions remain separate; canonical source wording retained with no speculative copy rewrite.

checks.item: **Motion motivated**: every animation can be justified in one sentence (hierarchy / storytelling / feedback / state transition), no GSAP-for-show?
checks.evidence: No new animation; static state/active feedback only.

checks.item: **Marquee max-one-per-page**: no two horizontal marquees on the same page?
checks.evidence: No marquee introduced.

checks.item: **Navigation on ONE line** at desktop, height ≤ 80px?
checks.evidence: 16 typography cases include desktop navigation at 1024/1280/1440; one row and <=80px.

checks.item: **Section-Layout-Repetition** check: no two sections share the same layout family (at least 4 different families across 8 sections)?
checks.evidence: No section-family or whole-site redesign.

checks.item: **Bento has rhythm AND exact cell count** (N items → N cells, no empty cells in middle or at end)?
checks.evidence: No marketing bento; exact existing six functional groups retained.

checks.item: **Long lists use the right UI component** (not default `<ul>` with `divide-y` for > 5 items - see Section 4.9 alternatives)?
checks.evidence: Existing grouped native disclosure/local list plus lookup retained.

checks.item: **Real images used** (gen-tool first, then Picsum-seed, then explicit placeholder slots) - NO div-based fake screenshots, NO hand-rolled decorative SVGs, NO pure-text minimalism?
checks.evidence: No new visual/media section; existing generated work illustration reused.

checks.item: **No pills/labels overlaid on images** (no `Plate · Brand`, no `Field notes - journal`)?
checks.evidence: No image overlays introduced.

checks.item: **No photo-credit captions as decoration** (`Field study no. 12 · Ines Caetano`)?
checks.evidence: No decorative credits added.

checks.item: **No version footers** (`v1.4.2`, `Build 0048`) on marketing pages?
checks.evidence: No visible build/version footer introduced.

checks.item: **No micro-meta-sentences** under eyebrows ("Each of these is a feature we ship today...")?
checks.evidence: No new editorial micro-meta copy.

checks.item: **No decoration text strip at hero bottom** (`BRAND. MOTION. SPATIAL.`)?
checks.evidence: No hero changes.

checks.item: **No floating top-right sub-text** in section headings?
checks.evidence: No floating corner explainer.

checks.item: **No scoring/progress bars with filled background tracks** as comparison visuals?
checks.evidence: No scoring bars introduced.

checks.item: **No locale / city-name / time / weather strips** unless brief is genuinely globally-distributed or place-focused?
checks.evidence: Only existing language preference utility; no city/time/weather decoration.

checks.item: **No scroll cues** (`Scroll`, `↓ scroll`, `Scroll to explore`)?
checks.evidence: No scroll cue introduced; existing homepage outside repair.

checks.item: **No version labels in hero** (V0.6, BETA, INVITE-ONLY) unless the brief is a launch?
checks.evidence: No hero changes.

checks.item: **No section-numbering eyebrows** (`00 / INDEX`, `001 · Capabilities`, `06 · how it works`)?
checks.evidence: No numbered eyebrows introduced.

checks.item: **No decorative dots** (zero by default, only for real semantic state)?
checks.evidence: No decorative status dots introduced.

checks.item: **No `border-t` + `border-b` on every row** of long lists / spec tables?
checks.evidence: No new table/list separator pattern; category disclosure has one meaningful body separator.

checks.item: **Content density** sane: no 20-row data tables, no fake-precise specs without justification, ≤ 25-word sub-paragraphs by default?
checks.evidence: Model-backed 70 skills retained; names/IDs/purposes structured and locally scrollable, no invented metrics.

checks.item: **Quotes ≤ 3 lines** of body, attribution clean (no em-dash)?
checks.evidence: No testimonial/quote component changed.

checks.item: **Motion claimed = motion shown**: if `MOTION_INTENSITY > 4`, page actually animates, not just claimed?
checks.evidence: Dial 2; intentionally static, no unfulfilled high-motion claim.

checks.item: **GSAP sticky-stack / horizontal-pan** implemented per Section 5.A / 5.B canonical skeleton (`start: "top top"`, `pin: true`, correct scrub)?
checks.evidence: No GSAP/scroll stack.

checks.item: **No `window.addEventListener('scroll')`** - using Motion `useScroll()` / ScrollTrigger / IntersectionObserver / CSS scroll-driven animations only?
checks.evidence: No new scroll event handler; native CSS scroll margins reserve sticky/overlay space.

checks.item: **Reduced motion** wrapped for everything `MOTION_INTENSITY > 3`?
checks.evidence: No added animation; dial 2 and existing static interactions retained.

checks.item: **Dark mode** tokens defined and tested in both modes?
checks.evidence: Both theme matrices, contrast and inspected actual screenshots.

checks.item: **Mobile collapse** explicit (`w-full`, `px-4`, `max-w-7xl mx-auto`) for high-variance layouts?
checks.evidence: Original single-column mobile categories and bounded/pannable graph retained; full geometry checks pass.

checks.item: **Viewport stability**: `min-h-[100dvh]`, never `h-screen`?
checks.evidence: Existing dynamic-viewport sheet and native page retained; no h-screen introduced.

checks.item: **`useEffect` animations** have strict cleanup functions?
checks.evidence: Native ESM/CSS; no React effect.

checks.item: **Empty / loading / error** states provided?
checks.evidence: Native/source fallback, no-match lookup and clipboard denied/absent/stale checks retained.

checks.item: **Cards omitted** in favor of spacing where possible?
checks.evidence: Owner-approved functional category/skill hierarchy retained; removing it would change the chosen scheme.

checks.item: **Icons** from an allowed library only (Phosphor / HugeIcons / Radix / Tabler), no hand-rolled SVG paths?
checks.evidence: No icon changes or new drawn SVG; existing graph is real relationship data, not decorative illustration.

checks.item: **Motion** isolated in client-leaf components with `'use client'` at the top, memoized?
checks.evidence: No animation framework/client component introduced.

checks.item: **No AI Tells** from Section 9 (Inter as default, AI-purple, three-equal cards, Jane Doe, Acme, "Quietly in use at")?
checks.evidence: No gradients/glass/novel icons/template marketing additions; source-backed six functional groups are explicit context exception.

checks.item: **Core Web Vitals** plausibly hit (LCP < 2.5s, INP < 200ms, CLS < 0.1)?
checks.evidence: Local Lighthouse module unavailable. No download/execution or Lighthouse/Core Web Vitals pass claimed.

checks.item: **One design system** per project (no Material + shadcn mixed)?
checks.evidence: One existing native token family; no package/style-system mixing.
